tei:div.tei:p: This prayer for the well-being for the citizens of Syria and residents of Aleppo was first published by the Masorti Movement in Israel, via their web page here. In this article from the Jewish Telegraphic Agency, the prayer is attributed to Ze’ev Keinan. The prayer was transcribed to Unicode Hebrew by Aharon Varady. After we initially posted our own translation, Zeev Keinan graciously shared his translation first posted at the Masorti website here.
